tour_title: Vietnam Rails, Mountains and Shores with Saigon Finale
lede: A Privately Arranged Family Journey from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City.
travel_style: Early check-in in Hanoi included. Private guide & vehicle throughout.
route_txt: Hanoi – Halong Bay – Sapa – Da Nang – Hoi An – Ho Chi Minh City
overview_heading: " Vietnam Rails, Mountains and Shores with Saigon Finale"
overview_h2: Prepared for: Sara (2 Pax) — 14 Days 13 Nights - Tailor-made for Sara
overview_p: A bespoke 14-day private journey through Vietnam designed for Sara. Experience the timeless charm of Hanoi, the breathtaking karst landscape of Ninh Binh, an exclusive overnight stay on Emeraude Classic Cruise in Ha Long Bay, the misty mountain valleys of Sapa via Chapa Express Train, coastal beauty in Da Nang & Hoi An, and a dynamic grand finale in Ho Chi Minh City.
overview_paras: This 14-day grand journey is tailored to capture the full cultural and natural essence of Vietnam from North to South.

Featuring handpicked boutique accommodations such as Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa, Emeraude Classic Cruise, Chapa Express Train, Sapa Jade Hill Resort, Radisson RED Danang Hotel, La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa, and Mai House Saigon.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Graceful Hanoi Arrival & Evening Stroll
description: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arriving at Noi Bai International Airport, your private driver meets you for a seamless transfer into vibrant Hanoi. Check into the luxurious La Siesta Classic Hanoi Hotel and take time to unpack and unwind. In the evening, savor a delicious welcome dinner before enjoying a gentle evening walking tour around the city's charming streets.
activities: Noi Bai International Airport, Hanoi, La Siesta Classic Hanoi Hotel

itinerary.title:
Day 2: Scenic Ninh Binh: Ancient Capitals & Karst
Waterways
description:
Depart Hanoi behind as you journey south through picturesque rural landscapes toward the historical region of Ninh Binh. Begin your morning exploration at Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, where you will wander through historic sanctuary temples built in honor of the ancient Dinh and Le royal dynasties while learning about Vietnam’s rich royal legacy amidst majestic rising limestone cliffs.
After enjoying a delicious local lunch featuring traditional regional specialties, proceed to the breathtaking UNESCO-listed Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex. Board a hand-rowed sampan boat to glide along emerald waterways, drifting beneath towering karst peaks, navigating hidden river caves, and taking in serene countryside views before relaxing on your comfortable private transfer back to Hanoi.
activities: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex
notes: Starts at 8:00 AM for about 10-11 hours

itinerary.title:
Day 3: Immersive Ha Long Bay: Boarding Emeraude Classic
Cruise
description: Depart Hanoi on a comfortable morning scenic transfer toward the stunning coastal shores of northeastern Vietnam. Upon arrival at the harbor, board the magnificent Emeraude Classic Cruise for an unforgettable voyage across the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay. Enjoy a refreshing welcome drink, savor a gourmet buffet lunch on board, and take in the panoramic views of iconic towering limestone islets as your cruise sails gracefully into the serene bay.
activities: Emeraude Classic Cruise, Ha Long Bay

itinerary.title: Day 4: Tranquil Ha Long Sunrise & Return to Hanoi
description: Wake up early to witness a tranquil morning over the waters of Ha Long Bay. After completing check-out procedures and disembarking from your cruise, meet your driver for a comfortable highway transfer back to Hanoi. Arrive back in the bustling capital by early afternoon and enjoy a completely free day to relax, explore hidden cafe nooks, or shop at leisure along the historic, vibrant streets of the historic city center.
notes: Starts at 11:00 AM for about 4 hours

itinerary.title:
Day 5: Historic Hanoi Heritage & Overnight Express
to Sapa
description:
Begin your immersive city exploration visiting the solemn Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, learning about the nation's historic founding leader before admiring the unique lotus-inspired architecture of One Pillar Pagoda. Continue your cultural journey to the ancient Temple of Literature, Vietnam's very first national university established in 1070, featuring historic courtyards, stone steles, and beautiful traditional pavilions.
Following a tasty local lunch, visit the serene Tran Quoc Pagoda situated peacefully on the shores of West Lake. Walk around romantic Hoan Kiem Lake, browse bustling stalls at Dong Xuan Market, and experience the iconic Hanoi Train Street. In the evening, transfer to the railway station to board the comfortable Chapa Express Train for your overnight journey to Sapa.
activities: Highlights of Hanoi, Chapa Express Train
notes: Starts at 8:00 AM for about 9-10 hours

itinerary.title: Day 6: Majestic Sapa Peak: High Altitude Sacred Fansipan
description: Arrive in Sapa in the morning and transfer to your hotel for rest and relaxation after your overnight train journey. In the afternoon, embark on an exciting mountain excursion riding the spectacular Fansipan Cable Car up toward the roof of Indochina. Marvel at majestic panoramic valley views before visiting sacred mountain sites including the towering Amitabha Buddha Statue, the impressive Great Bell Tower, and the serene spiritual atmosphere of Bao An Temple.

itinerary.title:
Day 7: Active Sapa Highlands: Ethnic Culture &
Sky-High Passes
description:
Embark on a captivating cultural trek down into the scenic valley to visit traditional Cat Cat Village, home to the Black Hmong ethnic community. Discover authentic timber stilt houses, observe age-old local handicrafts like indigo dyeing, and admire the cascading rushing waters of Tien Sa Waterfall set against dramatic terraced rice paddies before sitting down for lunch.
In the afternoon, travel along scenic mountain roads up to the breathtaking O Quy Ho Mountain Pass, famous for its sweeping high-altitude panoramic views. Next, test your courage at the thrilling Rong May Glass Bridge suspended high above the valley, and admire the thunderous cascading waters of majestic Silver Waterfall before returning comfortable back to Sapa town.
activities: Cat Cat Village, Tien Sa Waterfall, O Quy Ho Mountain Pass, Rong May Glass Bridge, Silver Waterfall
notes: Starts at 8:00 AM for about 9-10 hours

Visit Marble Mountains, where caves, pagodas and viewpoints reveal one of the city’s most recognisable natural sites. Continue to Son Tra Peninsula (Linh Ung Pagoda), Dragon Bridge, and local cultural spots.

Marvel at majestic panoramic valley views before visiting sacred mountain sites including the towering Amitabha Buddha Statue, the impressive Great Bell Tower, and the serene spiritual atmosphere of Bao An Temple.

itinerary_days.title:
Day 7: Active Sapa Highlands: Ethnic Culture &
Sky-High Passes
description:
Embark on a captivating cultural trek down into the scenic valley to visit traditional Cat Cat Village, home to the Black Hmong ethnic community. Discover authentic timber stilt houses, observe age-old local handicrafts like indigo dyeing, and admire the cascading rushing waters of Tien Sa Waterfall set against dramatic terraced rice paddies before sitting down for lunch.
In the afternoon, travel along scenic mountain roads up to the breathtaking O Quy Ho Mountain Pass, famous for its sweeping high-altitude panoramic views. Next, test your courage at the thrilling Rong May Glass Bridge suspended high above the valley, and admire the thunderous cascading waters of majestic Silver Waterfall before returning comfortable back to Sapa town.
activities: Cat Cat Village, Tien Sa Waterfall, O Quy Ho Mountain Pass, Rong May Glass Bridge, Silver Waterfall

edited_fields.day_title_1: Day 1: Graceful Hanoi Arrival & Evening Stroll
edited_fields.day_desc_1_0: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arriving at Noi Bai International Airport, your private driver meets you for a seamless transfer into vibrant Hanoi. Check into the luxurious La Siesta Classic Hanoi Hotel and take time to unpack and unwind. In the evening, savor a delicious welcome dinner before enjoying a gentle evening walking tour around the city's charming streets.
edited_fields.day_highlights_1: Noi Bai International Airport, Hanoi, La Siesta Classic Hanoi Hotel
edited_fields.day_title_2: Day 2: Scenic Ninh Binh: Ancient Capitals & Karst Waterways
edited_fields.day_desc_2_0:
Depart Hanoi behind as you journey south through picturesque rural landscapes toward the historical region of Ninh Binh. Begin your morning exploration at Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, where you will wander through historic sanctuary temples built in honor of the ancient Dinh and Le royal dynasties while learning about Vietnam’s rich royal legacy amidst majestic rising limestone cliffs.

After enjoying a delicious local lunch featuring traditional regional specialties, proceed to the breathtaking UNESCO-listed Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex. Board a hand-rowed sampan boat to glide along emerald waterways, drifting beneath towering karst peaks, navigating hidden river caves, and taking in serene countryside views before relaxing on your comfortable private transfer back to Hanoi.
edited_fields.day_highlights_2: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex
edited_fields.day_note_2_0: Starts at 8:00 AM for about 10-11 hours
edited_fields.day_title_3: Day 3: Immersive Ha Long Bay: Boarding Emeraude Classic Cruise
edited_fields.day_desc_3_0: Depart Hanoi on a comfortable morning scenic transfer toward the stunning coastal shores of northeastern Vietnam. Upon arrival at the harbor, board the magnificent Emeraude Classic Cruise for an unforgettable voyage across the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay. Enjoy a refreshing welcome drink, savor a gourmet buffet lunch on board, and take in the panoramic views of iconic towering limestone islets as your cruise sails gracefully into the serene bay.
edited_fields.day_highlights_3: Emeraude Classic Cruise, Ha Long Bay
edited_fields.day_title_4: Day 4: Tranquil Ha Long Sunrise & Return to Hanoi
edited_fields.day_desc_4_0: Wake up early to witness a tranquil morning over the waters of Ha Long Bay. After completing check-out procedures and disembarking from your cruise, meet your driver for a comfortable highway transfer back to Hanoi. Arrive back in the bustling capital by early afternoon and enjoy a completely free day to relax, explore hidden cafe nooks, or shop at leisure along the historic, vibrant streets of the historic city center.
edited_fields.day_note_4_0: Starts at 11:00 AM for about 4 hours
edited_fields.day_title_5: Day 5: Historic Hanoi Heritage & Overnight Express to Sapa
edited_fields.day_desc_5_0:
Begin your immersive city exploration visiting the solemn Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, learning about the nation's historic founding leader before admiring the unique lotus-inspired architecture of One Pillar Pagoda. Continue your cultural journey to the ancient Temple of Literature, Vietnam's very first national university established in 1070, featuring historic courtyards, stone steles, and beautiful traditional pavilions.

Following a tasty local lunch, visit the serene Tran Quoc Pagoda situated peacefully on the shores of West Lake. Walk around romantic Hoan Kiem Lake, browse bustling stalls at Dong Xuan Market, and experience the iconic Hanoi Train Street. In the evening, transfer to the railway station to board the comfortable Chapa Express Train for your overnight journey to Sapa.

top_level.letter_intro: I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey: " Vietnam Rails, Mountains and Shores with Saigon Finale", created for 2 passengers travelling from 30 Mar – 12 Apr 2027. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Halong Bay – Sapa – Da Nang – Hoi An – Ho Chi Minh City.
top_level.letter_body_p2: The programme has been considered around an active rhythm: early check-in in Hanoi, private guiding and transfers, a premium overnight train cabin, and enough space between active days to pause. Dining, room arrangements and transitions have been planned with care, without adding unnecessary movement.
top_level.letter_outro: Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation. Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices and family priorities.

1.hotel_intro: Nestled in the historic Ba Dinh district, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa blends French colonial charm with modern hospitality. It offers elegant rooms, a rooftop bar with spectacular city views, and a serene spa for a perfect urban retreat.

2.hotel_intro: Emeraude Cruises is a premier luxury cruise line operating in Ha Long Bay, managed by Thien Minh Group (TMG). Inspired by the legendary 1906 French paddle steamer, Emeraude offers a refined journey blending Indochine vintage charm with modern elegance and top-tier safety standards.

4.hotel_intro: Chapa Express Train offers premium overnight sleeper service between Hanoi and Lao Cai (Sapa). Featuring traditional wooden panels, comfortable air-conditioned cabins, clean amenities, and personalized passenger hospitality.

5.hotel_intro: Located in the scenic mist-covered hills of Sapa, Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa features stunning panoramic views of Fansipan mountain and Muong Hoa valley. Designed with local heritage details, the hotel offers comfortable heated bungalows, an outdoor pool, and local gourmet dining.

6.hotel_intro: Radisson RED Danang Hotel offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.

7.hotel_intro: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.

8.hotel_intro: Mai House Saigon Hotel is a luxury 5-star hotel ideally located in District 3, right next to the vibrant center of District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City. Featuring an elegant Neoclassical architecture with a touch of timeless nostalgia, Mai House offers guest spaces that blend modern luxury with warm hospitality and attentive service.
